tasks.title: Arrive and seat a patient from the Board
tasks.success: a-1042 status seated; two appointmentEvents writes

tasks.watch: could a wet glove hit each key without mis-tapping the neighbour?

tasks.title: Confirm the chair strip shows initials and no patient data
